slides.title: Introduction to Prompt Quality
content: Weak prompt leads to weak answer.
Great prompt leads to great answer.
Quality of output depends on input.
Pause and think: What makes a prompt 'good'?
slides.narration: A weak prompt often leads to a weak answer from the AI. Conversely, a great prompt yields a great answer. The quality of your output depends heavily on your input. Let us learn how to craft better prompts. Pause and think: What makes a prompt 'good'?
slides.image_prompt: A visual metaphor showing a 'weak prompt' as a small, blurry seed leading to a withered plant, and a 'good prompt' as a healthy seed leading to a thriving plant. Text: 'Weak Prompt -> Weak Answer', 'Good Prompt -> Good Answer'.

slides.title: The Three C's
content: Three key ingredients for best prompts.
slides.narration: The best prompts almost always include three key ingredients. We call these the three C's: Clarity, Context, and Constraints. Let us explore each of these in detail.
slides.image_prompt: A slide with a prominent title 'The 3 C's' and three distinct icons or bubbles labeled 'Clarity', 'Context', and 'Constraints', possibly interconnected.

slides.title: Clarity: Be Specific!
content: AI does not know your thoughts.
Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration: First, Clarity means being specific. The AI does not know what you are thinking. Vague prompts lead to generic and unhelpful answers. Look at this example. A weak prompt is 'Write about electric cars.' A good prompt is 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.' Notice the difference in specificity.
slides.image_prompt: A split slide. Left: A blurry question mark representing 'Weak Prompt' and a generic car image. Right: A magnifying glass over a detailed prompt box, showing the 'Good Prompt' text. Text: 'Clarity: Be Specific!'

slides.title: Context: Give it Background!
content: Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
Better Prompt (with Context): 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration: Second, Context tells the AI why you are asking. It also defines who the audience is. Context helps the AI adopt the right perspective. Let us refine our previous prompt. The good prompt was: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.' A better prompt, with context, adds: 'for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living.' This guides the AI's tone and focus.
slides.image_prompt: A slide showing a prompt box. Initially, the 'Good Prompt' is visible. Then, an added layer highlights the 'Context' portion of the 'Better Prompt', perhaps with a thought bubble or background image suggesting a lifestyle blog.

slides.title: Constraints: Set the Rules!
content: Better Prompt: 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'

Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments.'
slides.narration: Third, Constraints are boundaries that shape the output. Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need. Building on our better prompt, an excellent prompt adds constraints. We specify 'under 400 words' and 'use a friendly and enthusiastic tone.' We also add 'end with a question to encourage comments.' These rules ensure the output meets your exact requirements.
slides.image_prompt: A slide showing the 'Better Prompt'. Then, additional elements like a word count icon, a tone indicator (e.g., a smiley face), and a question mark icon are added around the prompt, highlighting the 'Constraints' to form the 'Excellent Prompt'.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
Example: 'Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food.'
slides.narration: Here is a bonus tip for you. Providing a persona is a super-powerful trick. Tell the AI who to be. For example, you can say: 'Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel.' Then, give your request. This helps the AI adopt a specific role and perspective.
slides.image_prompt: An icon of a person wearing different hats (e.g., chef, doctor, travel agent). Below, a prompt box highlights the 'Act as an expert travel agent...' part of the example prompt.

slides.title: Prompting with Examples
slides.narration: Now, let us look at prompting with examples. This concept is simple. It is about whether you give the AI an example to follow. We will discuss Zero-shot, One-shot, and Few-shot prompting.
slides.image_prompt: A visual showing three distinct paths or branches, labeled 'Zero-Shot', 'One-Shot', 'Few-Shot', emerging from a central 'Prompting with Examples' node.

slides.title: Zero-Shot Prompting
content: Simply ask for what you want.
slides.narration: Zero-shot prompting means you give zero examples. Most prompts you create are like this. You simply ask for what you want. All the examples we discussed earlier were zero-shot prompts.
slides.image_prompt: A simple prompt box with no preceding examples, just the direct request. A large '0' icon signifies 'Zero-Shot'.

slides.title: One-Shot Prompting
content: Example: 'Summarize text into key points like this: Text: 'The sun is a star, and it's the center of our solar system.' Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun' Now, use this format for the following text: [insert long article here]'
slides.narration: One-shot prompting means you give one example. This shows the AI the exact pattern you want. This is great for specific formatting tasks. For instance, you provide one example of summarization. Then, you ask the AI to apply that format to new text.
slides.image_prompt: A prompt box with one example pair (Input Text -> Desired Output Format) followed by the instruction to apply the format to new text. A large '1' icon signifies 'One-Shot'.

slides.title: Few-Shot Prompting
content: Pause and try: When is few-shot needed?
slides.narration: Few-shot prompting involves giving a few examples. This teaches the AI a more complex pattern. It is useful when the task requires understanding multiple variations. Pause and try: Can you think of a scenario where few-shot prompting would be necessary?
slides.image_prompt: A prompt box showing 2-3 example pairs (Input -> Output) demonstrating a complex pattern, followed by a request for new text. A large '3' (or 'few') icon signifies 'Few-Shot'.

slides.title: Summary
content: Explored the 3 C's: Clarity, Context, Constraints.
Better prompts lead to better AI interactions.
slides.narration: In this tutorial, we learned about the anatomy of a good prompt. We explored the three C's: Clarity, Context, and Constraints. We also discussed how providing a persona can enhance prompts. Finally, we understood Zero-shot, One-shot, and Few-shot prompting techniques. Remember, better prompts lead to better AI interactions.
slides.image_prompt: A summary slide with icons representing the 3 C's, a persona, and zero/one/few-shot concepts, all pointing towards a 'better AI interaction' graphic.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Draft an 'Excellent Prompt' for an AI.
Include Clarity, Context, at least two Constraints.
Specify a persona for the AI.
slides.narration: Here is an assignment for you. Draft an 'Excellent Prompt' for an AI. Your prompt should ask the AI to write a short product description for a new eco-friendly water bottle. Ensure your prompt includes Clarity, Context, and at least two Constraints. Also, specify a persona for the AI. Practice these skills to improve your prompt engineering.
